runners_data.name: Ka Mate Du Brivet
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who will dictate terms but may lack the class edge over this trip

runners_data.name: Broomfield Aderra
runners_data.note: Consistent performer with solid recent form who can adapt to prominent or tracking role

runners_data.name: Willshebe Court
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist whose recent form is questionable but could benefit from expected slow tempo

races.paceDynamic: Ka Mate Du Brivet will likely lead from the start with no other natural front runners in this small field. Broomfield Aderra will track in second while Willshebe Court drops in behind, creating a slowly-run race that will become a sprint from 3 furlongs out when the hold-up horse makes its move.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Ka Mate leads throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Ka Mate Du Brivet gets an uncontested lead and maintains stamina
scenarios.body: The leader will string out the field over this trip and prove hard to peg back despite the slow pace. Broomfield Aderra will chase home but cannot match the leader's stamina.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Broomfield kicks and wins
scenarios.trigger: If Broomfield Aderra travels well and has enough left to challenge
scenarios.body: The prominent runner will move up to challenge Ka Mate Du Brivet turning for home and outstay the leader in the final furlong. Willshebe Court will stay on from the rear without threatening.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Willshebe Court times late run
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and suits hold-up tactics perfectly
scenarios.body: Willshebe Court will benefit from the slow tempo to deliver a perfectly-timed challenge in the final 2 furlongs. The front two will tie up having gone too slow early then too fast late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy pace favors strongest
scenarios.trigger: If the three runners get into an early tactical battle with no clear leader
scenarios.body: All three will compromise each other's runs through indecisive tactics, leaving the race to the horse with most natural ability. Broomfield Aderra's superior recent form will tell in a scramble finish.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Ka Mate Du Brivet gets a soft lead as this natural front runner could prove very hard to catch
Monitor Broomfield Aderra's position turning in as this runner needs to be within striking distance
Check if Willshebe Court gets the slow pace required for hold-up tactics to be effective
Watch for tactical battles early if no horse wants to make the running in this small field
Observe the tempo through halfway as a crawling pace will strongly favor Willshebe Court's style

races.paceDynamic: Motazzen will dictate terms as the only confirmed front-runner, likely setting a steady gallop without pressure from the field composition. With Peking Opera, Vendant and Kylenoe Dancer likely tracking in behind, and the hold-up horses Geordies Betty, Godot and Wot You Wearing settling last, this creates a straightforward pace scenario where the leaders get an easy time of it early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Motazzen Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Motazzen gets an uncontested lead and maintains stamina over the extended trip
scenarios.body: The front-runner dictates a moderate pace and has enough left to resist late challenges. The hold-up horses find too much to do despite strong finishes.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too steady and the race sets up for closers
scenarios.body: Geordies Betty and Godot benefit from a truly-run race where front-runners tie up. The patient tactics pay dividends in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Peking Opera or Vendant can improve their recent disappointing efforts
scenarios.body: One of the prominent runners gets the perfect trip tracking the leader before striking decisively. They benefit from racing handily without doing too much early work.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Kylenoe Dancer Repeat
scenarios.trigger: If last month's course winner can reproduce that Fontwell form exactly
scenarios.body: Kylenoe Dancer follows identical tactics to recent success, sitting prominent before challenging late. The horse's proven course form becomes the decisive factor.

watchPoints.text: Motazzen getting too easy a lead early - if unchallenged through first mile, becomes very hard to peg back
Peking Opera's jumping - any mistakes will end chances from prominent position in small field
Godot's finishing effort - needs to be closing strongly from halfway to have any realistic chance
Vendant's position turning in - must be within striking distance to utilize recent placed form
Whether any prominent horse pressures Motazzen early - changes entire complexion if they do

races.paceDynamic: Four prominent runners (Ronnies Reflection, Valirann Gold, Daring Plan, Engaging Sam) create significant early congestion with no natural leader, likely producing a false pace through the early stages. The three hold-up horses (Kitsilano, Royal Juniper, Tom Desjy) will sit off this scramble, setting up a sprint finish where traffic problems 2-3 out could be decisive given the prominent congestion.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: False Pace Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet goes too slow early and bunches up approaching the business end
scenarios.body: Kitsilano and Royal Juniper get clean runs from their patient positions while the early pace horses tie up. The hold-up pair capitalize on superior finishing kicks over the tiring prominent runners.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Suits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If Ronnies Reflection or Valirann Gold establish genuine pace and maintain rhythm throughout
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes honest rather than false, suiting the prominent runners' natural styles. Ronnies Reflection's consistent soft ground form or Valirann Gold's tactical speed prevails over closing horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the four prominent runners cause significant interference 2-3 out while leaders tire
scenarios.body: The pace congestion creates a cavalry charge finish where positioning trumps class ratings. Engaging Sam or Daring Plan find clear runs while higher-rated rivals get hampered or stuck behind traffic.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Going Deterioration Impact
scenarios.trigger: If the soft ground becomes more testing during racing and affects stamina patterns
scenarios.body: Tom Desjy's going dependency becomes crucial as conditions worsen, while Ronnies Reflection's consistent soft form gives advantage. The pace collapses in the final furlong as ground takes its toll on less suited runners.

watchPoints.text: Tom Desjy's going dependency creates major risk if soft ground doesn't suit his limited recent form pattern
Traffic problems at 2-3 out are highly likely with Ronnies Reflection, Valirann Gold, Daring Plan and Engaging Sam all wanting prominent positions
Kitsilano needs to be produced with clear running room given his hold-up style and top rating
Royal Juniper's inconsistent recent form makes him unreliable despite suitable running style
Valirann Gold has been placing consistently but struggles to convert positions into wins

races.paceDynamic: With no genuine early leader and Unknown Entity, Graeme The Grey, Jambon, Grizzled Squirrel, and Last Round all likely to sit prominent, this will develop into a messy, tactical affair with no one wanting to commit. The lack of genuine pace-setters over 2m1½f on soft ground means a crawling gallop until the home turn, setting up a frantic sprint finish that will favor horses with tactical speed over stamina.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely with prominent runners checking each other
scenarios.body: The field bunches dangerously at the home turn before exploding into a cavalry charge up the hill. Raw class and finishing kick become decisive in the final 2f.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners go too slow and get swamped late
scenarios.body: Patient riders on the hold-up horses find clear runs as the pace quickens turning for home. The stamina-sapping soft ground catches the early prominent horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Unknown Entity Dictates
scenarios.trigger: If Unknown Entity takes responsibility and makes it a genuine test
scenarios.body: Unknown Entity's soft ground experience allows him to control the gallop and kick clear before others respond. His proven stamina on testing ground becomes the winning factor.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses hit the front simultaneously in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The tactical battle creates a messy finish with horses coming from all angles in the closing stages. Whoever finds the clearest path and responds quickest takes it.

scenarios.trigger: If The Gypsy Davey sets an even tempo without pressure from the prominent runners
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too steady for the leader to sustain his kick, allowing the hold-up horses to time their runs perfectly. Alien Storm and Rip Wheeler emerge from the pack to fight out the finish with their superior ratings.

scenarios.trigger: If both early leaders settle into false positions creating stop-start rhythm

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sprint Finish Benefits Class
scenarios.trigger: If pace collapses completely with no genuine pace pressure early
scenarios.body: The race becomes pure sprint from 3f out where higher-rated horses can unleash finishing kicks. Test The Market's OR105 rating and Hello Cello's proven turn of foot dominate lesser rivals in dash to line.
